vb_textbox.text: Red and Green gnomes are both short. Brown and purple gnomes are both tall. Select either a tall or short gnome to start and if you receive 3 or more mushrooms, continue to select that sized gnome. If you receive 2 or below mushrooms, try the other size gnome next. Continue to select the same sized gnome until that sized gnome provides 2 or less mushrooms, at which point you should switch to the other size.
